title: CUPID: Evaluating Personalized and Contextualized Alignment of LLMs from Interactions
reasoning: The paper focuses on personalization and contextual preference inference. While its preference taxonomy includes categories like 'Morality' and 'Harmlessness' as part of the broader alignment framework, the core contribution and evaluation are centered on the consistency of personal task preferences across different contexts rather than a deep evaluation or benchmarking of religious, faith-based, or ethical systems.
